name: io.github.mguttmann/the-real-unifi-mcp
title: UniFi Site Manager and Network (unofficial)
description: Unofficial MCP server for the UniFi Site Manager and Network cloud APIs, with a write-confirm guard.

environmentVariables.name: UNIFI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: UniFi Site Manager API key with Network scope (unifi.ui.com, Settings > API). It controls your whole network: treat it like an admin password.

environmentVariables.name: UNIFI_CONFIRM_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: Write confirmation: destructive tools return a preview and run only when called again with confirm "YES". Only false, 0, no or off turn it off.

environmentVariables.name: UNIFI_API_BASE
environmentVariables.description: API base URL; this host receives the API key. https origin only (http only for loopback test stubs). Keep the default.

environmentVariables.name: UNIFI_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Per-request timeout in milliseconds, covering response headers and body.

environmentVariables.name: UNIFI_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Log level on stderr: debug, info, warn or error.

environmentVariables.name: UNIFI_CONSOLE_ID
environmentVariables.description: Pins the UniFi console instead of discovering it (needed when the account has several consoles).

environmentVariables.name: UNIFI_NETWORK_SITE_ID
environmentVariables.description: Pins the Network site instead of discovering it.

environmentVariables.name: UNIFI_SITE_MANAGER_SITE_ID
environmentVariables.description: Pins the Site Manager site instead of discovering it.
